name: Cards Against Kin-manatee
purpose: A fill-in-the-blank party card game. Solo against computer players is free (no credits). Play with your Kin, or host friends and their Kins at a table (those use Kindroid credits).

actions.name: wake
actions.description: Open Cards Against Kin-manatee and see how the card game stands: round, points and who is Czar. Use when the person wants to play the card game or asks how it is going.
